data.name: Ganesan
data.gender_notes: Ganesan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ganesan is the name of the Hindu god with an elephant head, who is the remover of obstacles and the god of wisdom and knowledge. He is also known as Lord Ganesha or Vinayaka. This name represents power, wisdom, and good fortune. The name Ganesan carries the meaning “Elephant-headed god” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ganesan usually hope their child will grow to embody elephant-headed god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of wisdom, strength, and removal of obstacles.
data.etymology: Ganesan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elephant-headed god.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ganesan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Ganesan is a revered name in Hindu culture, and it is synonymous with strength, prosperity, and auspiciousness. Lord Ganesha, represented by this name, is invoked before the commencement of any new venture or important event to seek his blessings for its successful completion. The image of Lord Ganesha, particularly his large, curved-tusk elephant head, is a common sight in many Hindu homes and places of worship. Festivals such as Ganesh Chaturthi celebrate the arrival of Lord Ganesha and are marked with great joy and festivity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ganesan holds deep spiritual significance for Hindus, symbolizing wisdom, intelligence, and knowledge. Lord Ganesha, the god of wisdom, is believed to be the one who bestows knowledge, wisdom, and intelligence on his devotees. He is often invoked before studying or taking any important decisions. Furthermore, Lord Ganesha is also revered as the god of new beginnings and is known to clear obstacles, thereby making the name Ganesan and its associated deity highly auspicious in Hindu beliefs.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ganesan represents the destroyer of obstacles and the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge. His elephant head symbolizes strength, power, and the ability to overcome adversity. In Hindu mythology, Ganesan is revered as the god of wisdom, learning, and new beginnings.

historical_references.reference: Ganesh is known as the god of knowledge, wisdom and new beginnings. He is also the remover of obstacles, the god of success and the god of good fortune.
historical_references.context: Ganesh was popularized as a major deity during the Gupta Empire and later periods. He was especially revered by the Alvars, the medieval Tamil Vaishnavite saints.

historical_references.reference: Ganesh is believed to have been born to Subrahmanya and Parvati, the goddess of fertility and creation, to prevent the god Shiva from harming Parvati during her bath. Ganesh is also known as the elephant-headed god.
historical_references.context: The earliest known iconographic representation of Ganesh is found in the Ajanta Caves in Maharashtra, India. The Puranas, ancient Hindu texts, contain various stories about the birth and exploits of Ganesh.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Ganesan' is of Hindu origin and refers to the elephant-headed deity Lord Ganesha. In modern contexts, this name has gained popularity across various platforms. In film and television, there have been numerous adaptations and depictions of Lord Ganesha, with actors and actresses often taking on the name 'Ganesan' for their roles. On social media, the name has been used as a hashtag and in online communities to discuss Hinduism, pop culture, and technology. Lastly, in the gaming industry, the name 'Ganesan' has been used for characters and items in games, particularly those with Hindu themes or elements. The general trend is the continued relevance and influence of Hinduism in modern pop culture and technology, as well as the global spread and accessibility of these platforms.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Radha Ganesan in Kolkata, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Ganesan, which means "Elephant-headed god". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
